insight.headline: New fields for cash
insight.what_changed: New fields are now available on cash management resources in the GraphQL Admin API, providing more detail about cash drawer balances and cash count activities. The CashDrawerBalance field and the CashManagementActivity field have been added. These fields can be used to track and manage cash transactions more effectively.
insight.developer_impact: Developers can use these new fields to build more comprehensive cash management systems for merchants. They can query the GraphQL Admin API to retrieve the new fields and use them to update their apps. For example, they can use the CashDrawerBalance field to display the current balance of a cash drawer or use the CashManagementActivity field to track cash count activities. Developers should review the GraphQL Admin API documentation to learn more about the new fields and how to use them.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will have more accurate and detailed information about their cash transactions, which can help them manage their finances more effectively. They will be able to track cash drawer balances and cash count activities in real-time, which can help them identify any discrepancies or issues.
insight.why_it_matters: The new fields provide more detailed information about cash transactions, which can help merchants and developers build more comprehensive cash management systems. This can lead to more accurate financial reporting and better decision-making.
insight.code_example: query { cashManagementActivities { edges { node { id, cashDrawerBalance { amount } } } } }

recap.headline: Shopify updates enhance storefronts, fulfillment, and development tools

themes.title: Storefront Enhancements
themes.detail: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, and WebMCP support is available for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, enabling AI agents to interact with stores. Oxygen is also now available on development stores for Hydrogen storefront deployment.

themes.title: Fulfillment and Order Management
themes.detail: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, and Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps have been updated to better reflect real-world operations.

themes.detail: The CLI has been updated to version 4.6.1, which includes serving UI extension source maps during app development.
